1.web: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
1.asv: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

2.web: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.
2.asv: And it shall come to pass in the latter days, that the mountain of Jehovah’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

3.web: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go out, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.
3.asv: And many peoples shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.

4.web: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
4.asv: And he will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning-hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

5.web: House of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of Yahweh.
5.asv: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of Jehovah.

6.web: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.
6.asv: For thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they are filled with customs from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they strike hands with the children of foreigners.

7.web: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
7.asv: And their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

8.web: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
8.asv: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

9.web: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.
9.asv: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is brought low: therefore forgive them not.

10.web: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.
10.asv: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty.

11.web: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the haughtiness of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.
11.asv: The lofty looks of man shall be brought low, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.

12.web: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and haughty, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low:
12.asv: For there shall be a day of Jehovah of hosts upon all that is proud and haughty, and upon all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low;

13.web: For all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,
13.asv: and upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,

14.web: For all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,
14.asv: and upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,

15.web: For every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,
15.asv: and upon every lofty tower, and upon every fortified wall,

16.web: For all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.
16.asv: and upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant imagery.

17.web: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.
17.asv: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.

18.web: The idols shall utterly pass away.
18.asv: And the idols shall utterly pass away.

19.web: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
19.asv: And men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.

20.web: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
20.asv: In that day men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for them to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

21.web: To go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
21.asv: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.

22.web: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
22.asv: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for wherein is he to be accounted of?
